implementation: Optional immutable scope selection is carried from intake adoption into the formal task manifest; old unscoped tasks keep their contract
Current document identity, candidate kind and all declared predecessor delivery evidence are checked before a new task or operation
Task status, next_step, dependency graph and project review expose blocked plan evidence; stale delivery never counts as current project coverage
Direct lighting design/revision calls resolve their persisted parent task and enforce the same scope guard
Prior receipts remain replayable with current eligibility shown; new invalid operations create neither execution receipts nor adapter effects
Stale work can be explicitly prepared as a replacement under valid new predecessor evidence; the old task is not refreshed
limits: Cross-task model change, transitive staleness and re-preparation use synthetic persisted adapter stage stubs in unit tests; their delivery/PDF flags are not real native evidence
Actual MCP uses the existing explicit synthetic conditions-only fixtures and test-supplied interpretations, not unfamiliar customer input or an autonomous AI trial
Actual MCP verifies source revision invalidation; it does not add a new prospective native multi-task design or plan-change CAD acceptance
Scope association is explicit and optional, exact-source-bound, and task-identity-bound; older unscoped tasks are not retroactively governed and no globally newest project plan is inferred
A changed predecessor requires a new scope snapshot and explicit preparation of affected work; the old task cannot adopt a new scope or silently reuse its design
Checks are performed before operations and on subsequent reads; no cross-task transaction lock freezes upstream writers during a running native operation
This guard verifies declared evidence currency, not semantic sufficiency, actual geometric data transfer, standards applicability or professional coordination
No new external-user, new-machine, cross-model or professional acceptance; v2.0 and v2.1 frozen tags/packages remain unchanged
retainedFailure: The first adoption test omitted the frozen-condition passage from the scope citation and was correctly rejected by source coverage. Only the fixture citation was corrected; validation was not weakened.
